articles.title: Zelensky presses Nato for air defence systems after intense Russian strikes
articles.description: The Ukrainian president says "decisions for air defence" should be "one of the key outcomes" of this week's summit in Turkey.

articles.title: Woman suspected of Monaco bomb attack found dead in Ukraine
articles.description: Police had been hunting Anastasiia Berezovska after a Ukrainian millionaire was injured in the blast.

articles.title: Zimbabwean football star survives gun attack in South Africa
articles.description: South African police say they are investigating a case of attempted murder but that no arrests have been made so far.

articles.title: Far-right French leader Le Pen able to run in next presidential election after court ruling
articles.description: A French appeals court has cleared the way for Marine Le Pen to run in the 2027 presidential election - but with an electronic tag.

articles.title: US accuses China of nuclear proliferation after ballistic missile test
articles.description: The US called China's ballistic missile test in the south Pacific a "great concern" for the world.

articles.title: China carries out ballistic missile test hours after warning neighbouring countries
articles.description: China carried out a long-range ballistic missile test in the south Pacific on Monday, sparking criticism from New Zealand and Australia.
